pete_docs: Quick heads-up — updating Console cost widget examples to surface new metrics: token_cost_per_k, kv_cache_savings. Need a short migration note and example snippet adjustments.

ana_prod: Do we need to change API field names in the examples or just map them in the docs? We should avoid breaking customers copying examples.

kai_eng: Let's keep examples backward-compatible: show old field and new field side-by-side with a tiny mapping line. Eg: `cost.token_cost_per_k || cost.tokens_per_dollar` and a short callout explaining the rename.

pete_docs: Good. Also one broken link found pointing to /console/widgets/cost-old -> should be /console/widgets/cost. I'll include the redirect in the PR.

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck failed -> /console/widgets/cost-old (404).

ana_prod: Add a small note about rounding differences when converting per-token to per-1k tokens; customers noticed variance in totals. Keep it to 1 sentence.

kai_eng: Draft snippet for the dashboard preset JSON and a tiny JS example for the Console SDK showing both keys. Keeping examples <= 6 lines.

pete_docs: Please include a one-sentence migration checklist for support: which clients to notify and what telemetry to watch (cost spikes, missing token metrics).

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1218 — fixes link, adds migration note, updates examples. Lint OK. Linkcheck pending.

ana_prod: Reviewing now. Tiny nit: use "token_cost_per_k" in monospace in text and show the mapping code inline.

kai_eng: Approving. I added a tiny unit test in the SDK examples repo to ensure both keys are accepted.

docs-bot: Linkcheck: all links OK. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-1218--docs.redwood.ai/console/widgets/cost#migration

pete_docs: Verified preview. Merged PR 1218. I'll start a 72h support-watch to monitor for regressions. Thanks!
